clue.text: Turner is employed to do some of the cooking

definitions.text: Turner is employed to do some of the cooking

parts.words: Turner is employed to do some of the cooking
parts.note: the turner is not a person but a kitchen device that rotates meat on a spit while it roasts

explanation.walkthrough: Turner looks like a surname, perhaps a kitchen hand; read it literally as a thing that turns.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic description: a revolving spit that roasts meat is a thing that turns and cooks.

clue.text: The prophet of television

parts.note: the name of the teletext information service on British ITV was also a word for a seer who foretells the future

explanation.surface: A pundit who foresaw the rise of broadcasting.
explanation.walkthrough: From 1978 to 1992 the British ITV channels carried a teletext service, pages of text news on screen, whose name was a word for a seer.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic description: a seer giving forecasts, and the brand name of ITV's teletext service.

clue.text: Invite possibly about a hundred unemployed

indicators.note: about means the reworked letters go around the other two
possibly suggests the letters could be arranged another way

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: An invitation might go out to roughly a hundred people who are out of work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges INVITE to INTIVE, and 'about' wraps that round AC.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone idle or not working is not active.

clue.text: Standing still is not for women folk!

parts.note: a stag event is one for men only
a nation is a people, a folk

explanation.surface: Women are told they must keep moving rather than stay put.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase 'women folk' must be split: 'not for women' is one piece and 'folk' another.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a state of no movement or progress.

clue.text: Particular consideration

definitions.meaning: a particular is a detail or point, as in the phrase 'in this particular'
consideration is regard or esteem shown to someone

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses of one noun: a detail or aspect, and the regard shown to others.

clue.text: Get near as can be

indicators.note: as can be suggests the letters put into whatever order is possible

explanation.surface: Approach as closely as you possibly can.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to gain something as a reward for work is to get it.

clue.text: In brave hands this could be deadly

definitions.text: In brave hands this could be deadly

parts.words: In brave hands this could be deadly
parts.note: a brave is a Native American warrior, so this is the war axe he carries

explanation.surface: A weapon is lethal when a courageous person wields it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brave' reads as an adjective, but it is a noun: a Native American warrior.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic description: the light war axe of Native American warriors.

clue.text: A check on stock in a minor way

definitions.text: A check on stock in a minor way

parts.words: A check on stock in a minor way
parts.note: stock is livestock and a minor way a country lane, where bars set over a pit stop animals crossing

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper does a quick, small-scale count of goods.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests stocktaking; 'stock' is farm animals, 'check' a barrier and 'way' a road.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic description: bars across a rural road that stop farm animals straying.

clue.text: Breed of goats originating from Aragon

indicators.note: originating from says the answer is made out of the letters of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A kind of goat that first came from a region of Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: The breed is really named after Ankara in Turkey, not the Spanish region the surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a long-haired goat variety that yields mohair.

clue.text: Vehicles holding a leading position — they have staying power!

indicators.note: holding means the first piece has the others inside it

parts.note: cars are vehicles
the van is the front of an advancing army, the vanguard

explanation.surface: Vehicles at the front of a race keep their lead through endurance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vehicles' wants to be the definition, but it supplies letters; the definition is the joke after the dash, where 'staying power' is read literally as the means to stay overnight, and 'holding' marks the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic description: mobile homes give you the ability to stay wherever you park.

clue.text: The swan song showing taste

parts.note: a pen is a female swan
a chant is a sung or intoned piece

explanation.surface: A final performance that displays good judgement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swan song' is a set phrase for a last performance; split it into its two words.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a liking or inclination for something.

clue.text: Enchanting creature needing a little experience

indicators.note: a little means only a small stretch of the following word is taken

explanation.surface: A charming young thing who lacks worldly knowledge.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a fairy of Persian myth, a being that casts spells.

clue.text: He's expected to step out with due regard for the dog

parts.note: pace, from Latin, is said before a name to mean with due respect to that person
a setter is a breed of gun dog

explanation.surface: A man going for a walk is expected to think of his pet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'step out' means stride briskly: the runner who leads and fixes the speed of a race.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic description: the runner who leads a race strides out to fix its speed.

clue.text: Gather one is to hold a key by mutual arrangement

indicators.note: is to hold means the first piece takes the others inside it

parts.note: the ace is the one in a pack of cards
C is a musical key

indicators.note: arrangement means the letters of the word before it are put in a new order

explanation.surface: I understand someone will keep a door key, as both sides agreed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gather one is' reads as 'I understand one is'; the first word alone is the definition. 'is to hold' marks the container and 'arrangement' reorders the word before it, 'by' being only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to collect or amass.

clue.text: Well the fellow just doesn't want to work!

definitions.text: Well the fellow just doesn't want to work

parts.words: Well the fellow just doesn't want to work
parts.note: Well is not an interjection but the man's state of health: he is fit and only pretends illness to avoid work

explanation.surface: An exasperated remark about a lazy man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Well' looks like a sigh at the start of a sentence; it means healthy.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic description: a healthy person who shams sickness to dodge duty.

clue.text: Animal refuge that's about right for a certain group

indicators.note: about means the first pieces go around the single letter

parts.note: a cote is a shelter for doves or sheep
ie, id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A sanctuary for animals suits one particular set of people nicely.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a small exclusive circle of people.

clue.text: Incorrectly state it's most flavoursome

indicators.note: incorrectly says the letters that follow are in the wrong order

explanation.surface: Someone wrongly claims a dish has the best flavour.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the superlative of full of flavour.

clue.text: He may well be fired — but not for getting tight!

definitions.text: He may well be fired — but not for getting tight!

parts.words: He may well be fired — but not for getting tight!
parts.note: an idle worker risks the sack, and the word for him also means looser, the opposite of tight

explanation.surface: An employee could be sacked, though not for being drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tight' is slang for drunk in the surface; here it is the opposite of loose.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic description: an idler who shirks work, whose name also means looser.

clue.text: Falls for a rotter involved in more than one lawsuit

indicators.note: involved in means the scoundrel sits inside the legal word

parts.note: lawsuits are cases
a cad is a man who behaves dishonourably, a rotter

explanation.surface: Someone is smitten with a scoundrel who is mixed up in several court actions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Falls for' reads as a verb of infatuation; 'Falls' alone is the definition, as a noun or verb of tumbling water.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: waterfalls, or pours down in a stream.

clue.text: Construct the first inside in error

indicators.note: inside means the piece before it goes within the opening word

parts.note: to make is to construct
1st, written with I for the figure one, gives IST

explanation.surface: A builder wrongly assembles the interior before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a blunder or slip.

clue.text: Adjournment a put-up job?

definitions.meaning: an adjournment is a temporary halt to proceedings
read literally, something that has been hung up, like a car's springs or a bridge held by cables

explanation.walkthrough: A put-up job is normally a frame-up; here it is taken literally as something hung up.
explanation.definitionFit: A temporary stopping of proceedings, and the state of hanging from above.

clue.text: Fish in an endless variety of colour

indicators.note: endless means the following phrase's word loses its final letter

parts.note: a shade is a variety of a colour

explanation.surface: Fish come in a limitless range of hues.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' takes the final E from SHADE.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a herring-like food fish.

clue.text: Back a relentless union

indicators.note: union says the two pieces before it are joined together

parts.note: stern means severe and unyielding

explanation.surface: Support a trade union that never gives up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' reads as a verb, support; it is a sailor's word for behind, and 'union' simply joins A to STERN.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: nautical term for behind or to the rear.

clue.text: Sturdy but stupid lot

parts.note: thick is informal for stupid
a set is a lot or group of things

explanation.surface: A strong but dim bunch of people.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: stocky, solidly built.

clue.text: Kind and virtuous person without alternative

indicators.note: without in its old sense means outside, so the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: a saint, abbreviated St
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A gentle and good person who has no other choice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kind' reads as an adjective; it is the noun, a type. 'without' means outside, an old sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a type or variety.

clue.text: Contracts for trapping game

indicators.note: trapping means the first word catches the second inside it

parts.note: as can mean for, as in 'taken as dead'
bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: Legal agreements to snare wild animals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contracts' is a verb here, shortens; contract is also a term in the card game, a neat link.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: shortens or condenses.

clue.text: There's some point to a flower festival

parts.note: E, east, is one of the points of the compass
an aster is a daisy-like garden flower

explanation.surface: A show of blooms has some purpose after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a Christian feast in spring.

clue.text: Just supposing love is in the ascendant!

indicators.note: is in means the word before it sits inside the phrase that follows

parts.note: something ascendant is rising
love is a score of nothing in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: Imagine that romance is on the up.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: speculating, merely putting forward ideas without proof.
